name: Tempered plate armour
description: A full suit of quenched and tempered steel plate over a mail skirt and gussets, strapped and buckled at every limb. It turns almost any blade, at the cost of moving like a door.
notes: Laid out flat, front up, neck towards -z, about 1.3 to 1.5 m from collar to toe: the pieces a player finds as one set. CHECK LENGTH and VOLUME: the reference's longest side and volume are the suit packed together; the model lays it out so the pieces read. Pieces: a curved breastplate with a centre ridge, a three-lame fauld, a mail skirt below it and mail gussets at the armpits, shoulder cops with two lames, upper and lower arm plates round a winged elbow cop, thigh and shin plates round a winged knee cop, three sabaton lames. Tempered steel uses `steel-heat-tint`, mail `steel-mail` with `steel-mail-dark` ring rows, straps `leather-tan` with `brass-dull` buckles. Slot `vest` follows the earlier whole-body armour (the cardboard armour): Deadvox has no whole-body slot, and the suit goes over clothes. Protection is graded against the light and heavy suits that share its layout. The xl size shares the model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.
